title: Food = Kirieshki
body:
Transform familiar Minecraft food into a collection of popular crackers and snacks! This resource pack replaces the textures of most edible items with various Kiriyeshki flavors.

| Minecraft Item         | Replace                                              |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Apple                  | Kirieshki "Red Caviar"                               |
| Golden Apple           | Kirieshki "Bacon"                                    |
| Enchanted Golden Apple | Kirieshki "Ham and Cheese"                           |
| Bread                  | Kirieshki "Hunting Sausages"                         |
| Potato                 | Kirieshki "Tomato Spicy"                             |
| Poisonous Potato       | Kirieshki "Garlic"                                   |
| Baked Potato           | Maxi "Cheese Nacho"                                  |
| Carrot                 | Kirieshki "Salmon with Cheese and Tartar Sauce"      |
| Beetroot               | Maxi "Sweet Chili"                                   |
| Beetroot Soup          | Baguet "Bolognese"                                   |
| Melon Slice            | Kirieshki "Shashlik with Ketchup"                    |
| Glow Berries           | Kirieshki "Garlic with Cheese Sauce"                 |
| Sweet Berries          | Snekity "Cheese"                                     |
| Chorus Fruit           | Kirieshki "Salami"                                   |
| Cookie                 | Snekity "Sour Cream and Herbs"                       |
| Pumpkin Pie            | Baguet "Sour Cream and Cheese"                       |
| Mushroom Stew          | Kirieshki "Cheeseburger"                             |
| Suspicious Stew        | Baguet "Blue Cheese"                                 |
| Rabbit Stew            | Maxi "Shashlik"                                      |
| Beef                   | Maxi "Roast Beef"                                    |
| Cooked Beef            | Kirieshki "Steak with Barbecue Sauce"                |
| Porkchop               | Snekity "Pizza"                                      |
| Cooked Porkchop        | Baguet "Pizza"                                       |
| Chicken                | Maxi "Buffalo Wings"                                 |
| Cooked Chicken         | Kirieshki "Chicken"                                  |
| Mutton                 | Maxi "Lamb Shashlik"                                 |
| Cooked Mutton          | Baguet "Argentinian Ribs"                            |
| Rabbit                 | Snekity "Bavarian Sausage"                           |
| Cooked Rabbit          | Maxi "Black Pepper Steak"                            |
| Cod                    | Baguet "Lobster"                                     |
| Cooked Cod             | Maxi "Wasabi"                                        |
| Salmon                 | Kirieshki "Aspic with Horseradish and Mustard Sauce" |
| Cooked Salmon          | Kirieshki "Crab"                                     |
| Tropical Fish          | Maxi "Fried Shrimp"                                  |
| Pufferfish             | Light "Cream Cheese"                                 |
| Dried Kelp             | Grenki "Adjika"                                      |
| Rotten Flesh           | Kirieshki "Aspic with Horseradish"                   |
| Spider Eye             | Maxi "Kimchi"                                        |



Enjoy the game and bon appétit!
